activity_statements.statement: explores for and produces oil and natural gas from upstream assets globally including offshore platforms and onshore fields
refines crude oil into fuels, lubricants, and petrochemical feedstocks at refineries and chemical plants worldwide
operates a global LNG (liquefied natural gas) trading, supply, and shipping business
sells fuel, lubricants, and convenience products through a global network of retail service stations
employs 85,000 people across 70+ countries working on platforms, pipelines, offices, research labs, and retail sites
develops and sells biofuels, renewable electricity, and hydrogen as part of an energy transition strategy targeting net-zero emissions by 2050
reduced Scope 1 and 2 operational emissions by 36% vs 2016 by end of 2025, eliminated routine flaring from upstream operations in January 2025

name_reality_gap: none - Shell and 'Oil and Gas' accurately describes the dominant business. The growing renewables and energy transition segment is real but still small relative to hydrocarbon operations.
extraction_notes: Shell about page gave high-level firm description. Climate/energy future page provided specific emissions metrics and transition strategy details. Shell's business segments (Integrated Gas, Upstream, Chemicals and Products, Renewable) are publicly known; segment weights are approximate.
